definition: the parts that slow a car down
description: At a floodlit race track at night a dark blue sports car stops hard at the edge of the track, its front brake disc glowing bright orange behind the black wheel spokes, with sparks spraying from under the car. Another car streaks past as a red blur. The blue car then swings round towards the camera, its tyres smoking heavily, and slides sideways along the red and white kerb with the orange brakes still glowing. A stack of old tyres lies in the foreground, and a marshal post stands by a green light.

to lie stacked in the foreground
